How to add an email signature in Apple Mail

  1. Copy the rendered signature with Copy signature.
  2. In Mail, choose Mail → Settings → Signatures.
  3. Select your account, click +, and name the signature.
  4. Click the editor and paste. Uncheck Always match my default message font if needed.
  5. Set the signature as default for the account.
